infobox.usage: Unlocks the closed section on the second floor of the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Car dealership closed section key (LexOs sect.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the closed section on the second floor of the LexOs car dealership.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Your Car Needs a Service
- Used in the story chapter Blue Fire when you don't have a Mysterious room marked key

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Grate door on the second floor of the LexOs car dealership at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Technical supply crate
- 1x Wooden crate
- 2x Weapon box (6x2)
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)
- 1x Weapon box (6x4)
- 1x PC block
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Household materials, Other items)
- Car dealership director's office room key lock location
